items.text: सर्वेषामपि मुक्त्यर्थं मुक्तिमार्गस्य दर्शनम् देवेश ज्ञानमाचारं कृपया कथयस्व मे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ईश्वर उवाच ज्ञानाचारौ वरारोहे कथयामि तवाधुना प्रविशन्ति यतो मोक्षं ज्ञानिनो ध्वस्तकल्मषम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: येषां बोधेन संजातं कालज्ञानं वरानने न तेषां जायते बोधः शास्त्रकोटिशतैरपि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अतो हि निर्भयो विद्वान्निःशङ्को विगतस्पृहः ज्ञानोत्साहपरो भूयात् श्रद्दधानो निराकुलः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निर्ममः करुणोपेतः सर्वभूताभयप्रदः भजेत्कालोत्तरं देवि मुमुक्षुर्योगतत्परः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स ब्रह्मा स शिवो विष्णुः स इन्द्रः स षडाननः स गुरुः सर्वदेवाश्च स योगी स तपोधनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पण्डितः स महाभागः कृतार्थः परमार्थतः चलद्वायुसमं चित्तं ध्रियते येन निश्चलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स उपायो मिमोक्षस्य सदुपात्तगुणस्तु सः सा प्रज्ञा तदिह स्थैर्यं तत्पुण्यं व्यवसायिनाम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदेव तीर्थं दानं च स तपश्च न संशयः येनोपायेन बध्येत वायुभिश्चलनं मनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: चित्ते चलति संसारो निश्चलो मोक्ष एव तु तस्माच्चित्तं स्थिरं कुर्यात्प्रज्ञया परया बुधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एकान्तिकं सुखं यत्र तथाइवात्यन्तिकं भवेत् निष्कर्मणि परे तत्त्वे को न रज्येत पण्डितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निवृत्तो विषयज्ञानात् निष्कलज्ञानतत्परः अनिच्छन्नपि मेधावी लभते मोक्षमक्षयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अस्मिताकलया युक्तं चैतन्यं सकलं स्मृतमस्मितारहितं चेतश्चैतन्यं शक्तिरुच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथा प्रकाशितं विश्वं शक्तिध्यानमुदाहृतम् सर्वालम्बविनिर्मुक्तं निष्कलं ज्ञानमुच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अहमंशेन यच्छून्यं चिन्मात्रालोकमद्वयम् मुक्तिबीजं तदाख्यातं परयोगप्रवर्तकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: चक्राणि नाडयः पद्मदेवताबीजमण्डलम् रूपमित्यादिकं किंचिद्ध्येयं नैव कदाचन
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कुहकं मन्त्रजालं च प्राणायामादि धारणम् सर्वमेतन्न कर्तव्यं मोक्षमक्षयमिच्छता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नात्र पूजा नमस्कारो न जपो ध्यानमेव च केवलं ज्ञानमित्युक्तं वेदितव्यं न किंचन
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: बहिराहितचित्तानां जायन्ते बन्धहेतवः बहिश्चित्तं निवार्यैव विन्दन्लोके न सीदति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नात्र किंचिद्बहिर्नान्तं न मध्यं नाप्यधः क्वचित्सर्वाकारं निराकारं स्वसंवेद्यं विराजते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यद्यदालोक्य यो जन्तुः कुरुते कर्मसञ्चयम् तद्गतिर्जायते यस्मान्निरालोकं तु चिन्तयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: हेतुर्नास्ति फलं नास्ति नास्ति कर्म स्वभावतः असद्भूतमिदं सर्वं नास्ति लोको न लौकिकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निरालम्बमिदं सर्वं निरालम्बप्रकाशितम् निरालम्बमिदं कृत्वा निरालम्बो भविष्यति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: व्योमाकारं महाशून्यं व्यापकं यो न भावयेत्संसारी स भवेल्लोके बीजकोशक्रिमिर्यथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ज्ञानोत्पत्तिनिमित्तं तु क्रियाश्चर्याः प्रकीर्तिताः योगं सालम्बनं त्यक्त्वा निष्प्रपञ्चं विचिन्तयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पातालात् शक्तिपर्यन्तं सर्वमेतदभीप्सितम् भग्नं यैः शून्यमन्त्रेण ते स्मृताः शून्यवेदिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: विषये लोलुपं चित्तं मर्कटादपि चञ्चलम् सर्वशून्यपदे स्थित्वा ततो निर्वाणमेष्यति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वतत्त्वाद्यसंभिन्नं देहाद्भिन्नं तथैव च अहमस्माद्यसम्भिन्नं चैतन्यं सर्वतोमुखम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आकाशमिव सर्वं तु सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं प्रिये परानन्दमरूपं तु पश्यन्नानन्दभाग्भवेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निरिन्धनो यथा वह्निः स्वयमेव प्रशाम्यति ग्राह्याभावान्मनस्तद्वत्स्वयमेव प्रलीयते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मोहिका मूर्छिका माया स्वप्नश्चेति चतुर्विधः सुषुप्तिर्जागृतिश्चैव सर्वमेतत्परित्यजेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देहात्सूक्ष्मगतात्प्राणाच्चित्ताद्बुद्धेरहङ्कृतेः सर्वस्माद्भिन्न एवाहं चिन्तयन्लभते चितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सदाभिभूतये चित्तं निद्रया स्मरणादिना बोधयित्वा प्रयत्नेन कुर्यात्स्वस्थं पुनः पुनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यदा स्थिरं भवेच्चित्तं चालयन्न कथंचन न किंचिच्चिन्तयेत्तत्र स्थिरमेव तु कारयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आश्रयालम्बनं चित्तं तद्वत्कुर्यान्निराश्रयम् चञ्चलं निश्चलं कुर्यात् निश्चलं न तु चालयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वभूतलये जाते यद्यद्व्योम सुनिर्मलम् तत्तद्रूपं स्वकं ध्यायेद्व्याप्तं चैव तु निर्मलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदेव जन्मसाफल्यं पाण्डित्यमिदमेव हि चलद्वायुसमं चित्तं निश्चलं ध्रियते हि यत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नैवोर्ध्वं धारयेच्चित्तं न मध्यं नाप्यधः क्वचित् अन्तर्भावविनिर्मुक्तं सदा कुर्यान्निराश्रयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निद्रायां बोधयेच्चित्तं विक्षिप्तं शमयेत्पुनः पक्षद्वयपरित्यागे सम्प्राप्ते नैव चालयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निराश्रयं सदा चित्तं सर्वालम्बनवर्जितम् मनोऽवस्थाविनिर्मुक्तं विज्ञेयं मुक्तिलक्षणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वालम्बनशून्यं च धारयित्वा मनो हृदि यज्ज्ञानं जायते स्पष्टं तदभ्यासपरो भवेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ये ध्यायन्ति परं शून्यं निष्कलं निरवस्थितम् ते यान्ति परमं स्थानं जन्ममृत्युविवर्जितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देवा देव्यस्तथा चान्ये धर्माधर्मौ च तत्फलमाश्रयाश्रयिविज्ञानं संसारस्य च बन्धनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आश्रयो द्वन्द्वमित्युक्तं द्वन्द्वत्यागात्परोदयः जीवन्मुक्तस्तदा योगी देहत्यागाद्विमुच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वैराग्येण वपुस्त्यागो न वै कार्यो मनीषिणा आरम्भतः क्रियानाशे स्वयमेव विपत्स्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: हृत्सरोजे ह्यहंरूपा या चितिर्निर्मलाचला अहङ्कारपरित्यागात्सा चितिर्मोक्षदायिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तं चिद्रूपं यन्निरन्तरम् तच्छिवो ऽहमिति ध्यात्वा सर्वासक्तिं विसर्जयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देशजात्यादिसम्बद्धान्वर्णाश्रमसमन्वितान्भावानेतान् परित्यज्य स्वभावं भावयेद्बुधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अहमेको न मे कश्चिन्नाहमन्यस्य कस्यचित् न तं पश्यामि यस्याहं तं न पश्यामि यो मम
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अहमेव परं ब्रह्म जगन्नाथो महेश्वरः इति स्यान्निश्चितो मुक्तो बद्धः स्यादन्यथा पुमान्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अशरीरं यदात्मानं पश्यति ज्ञानचक्षुषा तदा भवति शान्तात्मा सर्वतो विगतस्पृहः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यो ऽसौ सर्वेषु शास्त्रेषु पठ्यते ह्यज ईश्वरः अकायो निर्गुणो ह्यात्मा सो ऽहमस्मि न संशयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: विज्ञाप्तिमात्रो हि सदा विशुद्धः सर्वत्र यस्मात्सततं विमुक्तः नादेयहेयो ह्यहमप्रतर्क्यस्तस्मात्सदा ब्रह्ममयो विशोकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आ मस्तकं पादतलावसानं सान्तर्बहिश्चर्मपटावनद्धम् तत्कृत्स्नमेवामृतरूपमन्यच्चिद्रूपमात्मानमनन्यसिद्धिम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ईशो ऽहमेवास्य चराचरस्य पिता च माता च पितामहश्च ध्यानं समास्थाय पदं चतुर्थं ध्यायन्ति मामेव विमुक्तिकामाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्रह्मादिभिर्देवमनुष्यनागैर्गन्धर्वयक्षाप्सरसां गणैश्च यज्ञैरनेकैरहमेव पूज्यो मामेव सर्वे प्रतिपूजयन्ति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तपोभिरुग्रैर्विविधैश्च दानैर्मामेव सर्वे प्रतिपूजयन्ति भूतानि चाहं स्थिरजङ्गमानि यावन्ति चान्यान्यहमेव तानि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न स्थूलसूक्ष्मो न च शून्यरूपो ज्ञानैकरूपो जगदेकबन्धुः निरन्तरो निर्मल ईश्वरो ऽहं स्वप्नाद्यवस्थाच्युतिनिष्प्रपञ्चः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अनादिविज्ञानमजं पुराणं गुहाशयं निष्कलमप्रपञ्चम् निरञ्जनं निष्प्रतिमं निरीशमदृश्यमग्राह्यमचिन्त्यरूपम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सनातनं ब्रह्म निरन्तरं यत्पदे पदे सो ऽहमिति प्रपश्येत् यो भावतस्तिष्ठति निष्प्रकम्पः स ब्रह्मभूतो ऽमृततामुपैति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ज्ञानमेवं वरारोहे कथितं मोक्षसिद्धये आचारं कथ्यमानं तु साम्प्रतं शृणु तं मया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न स्नानं न जपः पूजा होमो नैव च साधनमग्निकार्यादिकार्यं च नैतस्यास्ति महेश्वरि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नियमो ऽपि न तस्यास्ति क्षेत्रपीठे च सेवनम् नार्चनं पितृकार्यादि तीर्थयात्रा व्रतानि च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: धर्माधर्मफलं नास्ति न तिथिर्लौकिकक्रिया संत्यजेत्सर्वकर्माणि लोकाचारं च सर्वशः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: समयाचारनिःशेषान् कृत्यजातं तु बन्धनम् संकल्पं च विकल्पं च ये चान्ये कुलधर्मिकाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सिद्धीश्च विविधाकाराः पातालादि रसायनम् प्रत्यक्षेणापि लभ्येरन्नैव गृह्णीत साधकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वे ते पशुबन्धाः स्युरधोमार्गप्रदायकाः एतैर्नास्ति परा मुक्तिश्चिद्रूपं व्यापकं विना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: येन केन विशेषेण सर्वावस्थो ऽपि योगधृक्क्षेत्रपीठे च सन्देहाद्वर्जयेद्यदि कौतुकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कृमिकीटपतङ्गाश्च तथा देवि वनस्पतीन्न नाशयेद्बुधो जीवान् परमार्थमतिर्यतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न मूलोत्पाटनं कुर्यात्पत्त्रच्छेदं विवर्जयेत् भूतपीडां न कुर्वीत पुष्पाणां च निकृन्तनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्वयम्पतितपुष्पैस्तु कर्तव्यं शिवपूजनम् मारणोच्चाटनादीनि विद्वेषस्तम्भने तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ज्वरभूतग्रहावेशवश्याकर्षणमोहनम् न कुर्यात्क्षुद्रकर्माणि काष्ठपाषाणपूजनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: समो ऽमित्रे च मित्रे च समो लोष्टे च काञ्चने अभिलाषो न कर्तव्य इन्द्रियार्थे कदाचन
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आत्मारामो भवेद्योगी निर्भयो विगतस्पृहः समनिन्दाप्रशंसश्च सर्वभूतसमस्तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: समदृष्टिस्तु कर्तव्या यथात्मनि तथा परे विवादं लोकगोष्ठीं च कलहाश्च विवर्जयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शास्त्रगोष्ठीं न कुर्वीत कुभाषितसुभाषितान्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ईर्ष्यां पैशुन्यदम्भे च रागं मात्सर्यमेव च कामक्रोधौ भयं शोकं त्यजेत्सर्वं शनैः शनैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वद्वन्द्वविनिर्मुक्तः सन्ततं जनवर्जितः अनेनैव शरीरेण सर्वज्ञः सन् प्रकाशते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ज्ञानेनैव यथा मोक्षस्तथा सिद्धिर्निरर्थिका तथापि भोगमिच्छन्तः सिद्धिमिच्छन्ति साधकाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अणिमादिगुणावाप्तिर्जायतां वा न जायताम् तथापि मुच्यते देही पतिं विज्ञाय निर्मलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पञ्चभूतात्मको देहः शिवस्तत्रैव तिष्ठति शिवाद्यवनिपर्यन्तो लोको ऽयं शङ्करात्मकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ईदृशं ज्ञानिनं दृष्ट्वा पूजयन्ति च ये नराः गन्धं पुष्पं फलं धूपं स्नानं वस्त्रं च भोजनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निवेदयन्ति ये केचिद्वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः तथैव ते विमुच्यन्ते मुक्तिमार्गाभिकाङ्क्षिणः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्तुतिनिन्दाकरास्तस्य पुण्यपापे समाप्नुयुः यज्ज्ञानाचरणं पृष्टं तत्सर्वं कथितं मया कालज्ञानं वरारोहे किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
